US used expired missiles against Iran; navy gives odd 'stale bread' comparison
description: The US Navy recently acknowledged deploying expired munitions in operations against Iran. According to acting navy secretary Hung Cao, the military is dealing with dwindling weapon stockpiles. To address this, previously expired munitions were refurbished for operational use. However, utilizing outdated weapons poses risks, including safety concerns and the likelihood of failure to hit targets.

title: SoftBank sold Nvidia stake to fund OpenAI, now Son regrets passing on Anthropic
description: Masayoshi Son expressed regret over not investing in Anthropic, a maker of AI systems. SoftBank had chosen to invest in OpenAI instead of Anthropic, which Son now sees as a mistake. He mentioned that committing to one company can foster stronger partnerships, despite the advantages of diversification. After significant investments in OpenAI, SoftBank sold Nvidia shares to raise capital.

title: ‘There is no safe space’: Steyn reacts to Bancroft’s Sandpapergate revelations
description: Dale Steyn criticised the idea of a “safe space” for Cameron Bancroft after the Australian reopened the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal. Bancroft claimed the entire team knew about ball tampering and that he was made a scapegoat. He also admitted withholding details during Cricket Australia's investigation, saying the scandal and recent comments by Pat Cummins left him feeling betrayed.

title: Trump, JD Vance face scrutiny as incoming House Oversight chief targets 12 allies in sweeping new probes
Building weapons of tomorrow: Why China is desperate for Nvidia AI chips
description: China is reportedly attempting to obtain advanced Nvidia processors to advance its military modernization efforts. The Chinese military aims to integrate artificial intelligence into various operational areas, enhancing its strategic capabilities. Recent US export restrictions have limited China's access to these crucial semiconductor technologies. While domestically developed chips exist, they have not yet matched international advancements. The race for AI in military applications continues to escalate between the two nations.

title: Cyclone Akvan intensifies into severe storm, likely to make landfall by November 20
description: Cyclone Akvan has intensified over the Bay of Bengal and is moving towards Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. It is likely to make landfall between Narsapur and Puri on November 20, packing wind speeds of 90-100kmph. The IMD has issued red and orange alerts for several districts due to expected heavy rainfall and strong winds. Authorities are taking precautionary actions, including relocating vulnerable residents to safety.

title: 'Biggest pillar of CSK': Suresh Raina credits MS Dhoni for franchise's success
description: Former Chennai Super Kings batter Suresh Raina acknowledged Mahendra Singh Dhoni's pivotal role in the franchise's success. After announcing his retirement, Dhoni will now serve as a mentor for CSK. Raina reflected on Dhoni's emotional connection with fans and his leadership qualities during their successful years together. He also highlighted the physical challenges Dhoni faced leading to his departure as a player.

title: Texas man claims $105k of separate funds for home; court upholds divorce split
description: A Texas appellate court has confirmed a lower court's decision regarding the divorce property division between Julian and Alice Devon Poole. Julian claimed certain assets as his separate property, including his inheritance and savings. However, the court found he failed to substantiate his claims adequately, leading to a ruling that mandates an equal division of marital assets between the spouses, thus upholding the trial court's verdict.

title: Ken Griffin sells $45m Park Avenue duplex for $58m a year later to Jets owner
description: Ken Griffin sold his duplex apartment at 740 Park Avenue for $58 million to Woody Johnson. The deal, which was completed off-market, reflects a significant appreciation in value for Griffin since his purchase. Woody Johnson’s new acquisition adds to his existing real estate portfolio, which includes properties in New Jersey and Palm Beach.

title: Azam Khan walks out of Dasna jail after getting interim bail
description: Azam Khan, a prominent Samajwadi Party leader, was released on interim bail from Dasna District Jail. His release follows a ruling by the Allahabad High Court regarding a money laundering case against him. The court indicated that mandatory legal provisions were not adhered to during his arrest. Khan will now move to Rampur, where his son awaited his arrival outside the jail.

title: Coyote may be first to cross $114m California wildlife bridge before opening
description: In an exciting development, a coyote has been spotted utilizing a newly constructed wildlife bridge spanning California's US 101 Freeway. This innovative structure is designed to reconnect fragmented habitats caused by highways and urbanization. Researchers are actively observing wildlife interactions with the bridge through remote cameras, aiming to enhance the migration of various species, such as mountain lions and deer.

This collaboration focuses on upgrading the Barak point defence missile system's hardware and software to bolster its capabilities. The enhanced Barak system will reinforce the Indian Navy’s protection against aerial threats, ensuring improved extended-range air defence capabilities for its warships.

He stressed the necessity for trustworthy alliances and diversification amid economic uncertainties. Jaishankar further advocated for deepened collaboration between India and Japan across multiple sectors, as this could foster enhanced stability in the Indo-Pacific region.

During a hearing, justices highlighted the pristine condition of Ballard Estate before the arrival of important visitors. The court expressed disappointment that such efforts were not constant for all residents of Mumbai. It emphasized the necessity for ongoing cleanliness measures and stricter plastic bag regulations.

title: Arshdeep makes big jump in ODI rankings, Rohit Sharma slips after NZ series
description: Arshdeep Singh has made remarkable strides in the ICC ODI bowling rankings after an impressive series against New Zealand. He is currently tied for 19th place with Axar Patel, while Kuldeep Yadav has slipped to 15th. On the batting side, Rohit Sharma has dropped to fifth, and Shubman Gill retains the top spot.

title: Russian 'Bears' return to Vietnam after 12 years: Why Moscow's Tu-95 deployment matters
description: Russia's reintroduction of its nuclear-capable Tu-95 bombers to Da Nang airport marks a significant shift after 12 years. This deployment is poised to bolster Russia’s position in the increasingly tense Indo-Pacific environment. It also indicates changing military alliances for Vietnam, as it seeks to navigate its relationships with both Moscow and the encroaching influence of China in Southeast Asia.

title: $135 billion in debt, still getting loans: Who is keeping Pakistan afloat, and why
description: As of last year, Pakistan grapples with an external debt surpassing $135.1 billion. Despite ongoing financial assistance from global lenders and allies, the nation faces economic hardships marked by high unemployment and escalating poverty rates. A crucial creditor, China, plays a pivotal role in Pakistan's financial future, raising concerns about Islamabad's capacity to uphold its debt commitments independently.

Indian Grandmaster Srinath Narayanan criticised his conduct, saying, "Dignity and courtesy took a fall long before the rating," while FIDE official Emil Sutovsky also questioned his sportsmanship.

title: The Albatross at 50: how the Navy's eyes over the ocean evolved
description: November 18, 2026, marks the 50th anniversary of Long-Range Maritime Reconnaissance operations by Indian Navy. INAS 312, also known as Albatross, was commissioned in 1976 and has evolved significantly. The Indian Navy has enhanced its maritime surveillance capabilities to track increasing underwater threats. This includes the induction of modern aircraft like the P-8I to strengthen security. Continued investment in reconnaissance and anti-submarine warfare is crucial for safeguarding India's coastal integrity.

title: A yr after picking up gun: Kashmir’s last known active LeT terrorist meets his end
description: Mohammad Lateef Bhat, a wanted terrorist involved in multiple attacks, was killed in Kulgam after an extensive operation. Security forces had been searching for him and his associate following a series of violent incidents. The operation included attempts to persuade Bhat to surrender, which he refused. He was located in a mosque where he opened fire on security personnel.

The court ordered the sale of their $270,000 marital home while considering the father's financial situation. It reversed the decision requiring him to contribute to his daughter's college expenses due to his limited income. The appeals court directed adjustments to how parental contributions to optional activities should be split.

A mere 36% were able to resolve these incidents within 24 hours, exposing governance weaknesses. While 51% had automated systems to detect unusual behavior, 67% lacked automatic response capabilities. Moreover, 37% found unregistered AI agents in their systems in the past year.

title: From drones to cruise missiles: Inside Ukraine's op to cripple Putin's prized bridge
description: Ukraine executed a sophisticated attack utilizing 11 drones and missile systems targeting the strategically vital Kerch Bridge. This operation, confirmed by President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, was orchestrated by the Security Service of Ukraine and military branches. The bridge is crucial for Russian logistical support and serves as a significant symbol of power, with the assault impacting both military and civilian supply chains linking Crimea to Russia.

title: EXCLUSIVE | Rachin Ravindra: A father's lessons go beyond the boundary
description: Rachin Ravindra's rise to international cricket has not changed life for his father, Ravi Krishnamurthy, who continues to balance his software engineering career with coaching at Hutt Hawks. From nurturing young New Zealand talent to giving his son space away from cricket, Ravi's philosophy remains simple: becoming a good human being matters more than becoming the best cricketer.

title: 'Purity of voter list': CM Yogi defends SIR after 'missing' Hindu voters claim
description: Yogi Adityanath has staunchly defended the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, emphasizing its role in maintaining the integrity of voter lists. He highlighted the necessity of removing deceased individuals and non-citizens from the rolls. With the upcoming assembly elections on the horizon, Adityanath expressed firm confidence in the BJP's ability to secure victory.

Devdutt Padikkal will hold the No.3 batting position after strong showings in prior matches. However, Sai Sudharsan won't be part of the squad, needing additional experience in longer games. India aims to better its history in New Zealand this time around.

He also claimed regular discussions with bowlers showed they knew about the sandpaper use.

Brittany Mahomes, one of the founding owners, significantly contributed to this growth since 2020. With unparalleled league revenue of $36 million, the club is in a strong financial position. The recent addition of co-owner Patrick Mahomes in 2023 further enhances their profile.
